subject: [Invite] AI Execs Dinner in Zurich Altstadt - 2nd July
text:
Hi [NAME], 

We're hosting an intimate private dinner for AI & Computer Vision Leaders in Zurich's Altstadt on Wednesday 2nd July and we'd love for you to join us, if you're available. 

It'll be an informal, open-format evening - no slides or pitches, just bringing together like-minded people to discuss their experiences & challenges building AI companies. The venue will be a private room in one of the Old Town's top spots - with details to be finalised by the end of next week. 

Attendance is reserved for senior leaders (Co-founders / CTOs / Heads of AI / Product etc.) from existing Encord partners and other leading AI/ML scale-ups and organisations - with confirmed attendees including leaders from Sportradar, ABB, and Synthesia. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're a data development platform built to help AI teams bring better models to market, faster. We work with over 200 teams including Woven-Toyota, Pickle Robot, & Carbon Robotics, and have offices in SF & London. 

Would you be interested in joining? Let me know and I can ask the team to send over details once confirmed,

text:
Hi [NAME], 

Our Head of AI is hosting an exclusive fireside chat for AI leaders during CVPR with Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, Chief R&D officer at Nexar), followed by an intimate roundtable dinner - & we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests at Moto Cucina - about a 15 min walk from the conference - on Saturday 14th June, starting at 6:30 PM. Attendees are strictly reserved for senior leaders (Co-founders / CTOs / Heads of AI etc.) from existing Encord partners and other leading AI/ML scale-ups and organisations - with confirmed attendees including leaders from Captions, Woven-by-Toyota, and Pickle Robot.

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're a data development platform built to help teams bring better models to market, faster. We work with over 200 AI teams including Woven-Toyota, Synthesia, & Hudl, and have offices in SF & London.

Would you be interested in joining?

subject: ATLANTIS - multimodal patient data for diagnostics
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw you're growing your diagnostics and patient data management tooling - imagine scaling your MLOps pipeline is top of mind at the moment. Imagine your K Navigator and DrugMATCH pipelines likely require extensive data labelling across modalities. 

Thought to reach out as we've worked extensively with your medical diagnostics/imaging peers - Aignostics, Paige.ai - on managing data heavy pipelines, scaling annotation capabilities and introducing model evaluation workflows to enable teams to iterate on their models at pace. 

Would it make sense to chat for 20 mins about what we're seeing in the space? Thursdays and Fridays work well for me.

Our Head of AI is hosting an exclusive fireside chat for AI leaders during CVPR with Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, Chief R&D officer at Nexar), followed by an intimate roundtable dinner - & we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests at Moto Cucina - about a 15 min walk from the conference - on Saturday 14th June, starting at 6:30 PM. Attendees are strictly reserved for senior leaders (Co-founders / CTOs / Heads of AI etc.) from existing Encord partners and other leading AI/ML scale-ups and organisations - with confirmed attendees including leaders from Captions, Woven-by-Toyota, and Pickle Robot.

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're a data development platform built to help teams bring better models to market, faster. We work with over 200 AI teams including Woven-Toyota, Synthesia, & Hudl, and have offices in SF & London.

Would you be interested in joining?

subject: ATLANTIS - multimodal patient data for diagnostics
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw you're growing your diagnostics and patient data management tooling - imagine scaling your MLOps pipeline is top of mind at the moment. Imagine your K Navigator and DrugMATCH pipelines likely require extensive data labelling across modalities. 

Thought to reach out as we've worked extensively with your medical diagnostics/imaging peers - Aignostics, Paige.ai - on managing data heavy pipelines, scaling annotation capabilities and introducing model evaluation workflows to enable teams to iterate on their models at pace. 

Would it make sense to chat for 20 mins about what we're seeing in the space? Thursdays and Fridays work well for me.

text:
Hi [NAME],​

I was reading about Amelia 7.0's ASR capabilities & thought I'd reach out. I lead a Conversational AI team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) - we're actually working with a few of your peers (Synthesia, Twilio, ElevenLabs, Cerence, etc) on developing new models / improving existing ones for use cases like ASR, TTS, STT, NER, etc. 

For context, I met some of your colleagues at NVIDA GTC who mentioned that it might be interesting to reach out. Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building here if you have 15 mins to chat over the coming weeks? I'm usually open Thursday / Friday.

subject: Scaling CV data pipelines
text:
Hey [NAME]​, 

Noticed that [COMPANY] has recently been growing its AI & Computer Vision teams, so thought I'd reach out to introduce myself. 

I lead the Drones & Robotics team here at Encord, working with a few of your adjacent peers (including Shield AI, Dedrone, & DroneShield) - helping them to move away from open-source starter tools like CVAT + Voxel 51, and towards a more scalable Enterprise-grade data management solution that brings together multimodal data curation & annotation in a single platform.

Let me know if you're be open to a 30-minute chat later this week? Thursday or Friday quite open for me at the moment,
